scope: Focused offline tests of actual production provider code with canned HTTP and a virtual clock. No API keys, network, browser, device actuation, or complete five-trial experiment.
checks: Start-to-start spacing, BUSY while waiting, and no added delay after a slow response
429 honors Retry-After seconds and HTTP dates before returning one validated proposal
At most two retries; every generation attempt consumes the existing call budget
Bridge call budget is terminal and cannot be retried as a temporary 429
Daily, spending, and zero quota signals are terminal without automatic retries
Server waits over 180 seconds stop explicitly and are never shortened into an early retry
Abort during cooldown or spacing cancels waiting and prevents another fetch
Cooldown is outside the HTTP timeout; actual request timeout remains enforced
A recovered HTTP request still obeys tool bounds; invalid decisions receive no transport retry
Claude resends a model request once after a timeout or HTTP 5xx (500/502/504/529), counted in the call budget; 4xx, an exhausted budget, maxTransientRetries 0 and Gemini get no resend
Request diagnostics and wait status remain bounded and omit keys and raw HTTP errors
note: Copy of the tests/test_v63_provider_pacing.cjs output after the 2026-10-14 transient-retry change; validation/v63-provider-pacing.json is kept as the historical record.
